t: Real Research Today: Blended Wing Airliners 2.0
title: Real Research Today: Blended Wing Airliners 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Blended Wing Airliners 2.0.
description:
The road to Blended Wing Airliners 2.0 is already being paved. The eVTOL industry (Joby, Archer, Lilium) certifies electric air taxis with aviation authorities. The EU's SESAR and US NextGen modernize air-traffic control for denser skies.

Stratospheric balloons and airships (Sceye, Flying Whales) return as cargo platforms. Together these programs form the BWB frames foundation that Blended Wing Airliners 2.0 will build on — the airliner logistics results, the evacuation design methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as airliner logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Blended Wing Airliners 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Blended Wing Airliners 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Blended Wing Airliners 2.0 — next-gen flying-wing passenger jets.

Phase 1 — Prove (BWB frames): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (airliner logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (evacuation design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (airport fit): airliner hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and aviation-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
